# Dashmark Documentation

> Dashmark is a lightweight dashboard for Docker services.

## Documentation

- [Complete documentation](https://edmogeor.github.io/dashmark/docs/llms-full.txt): All Dashmark documentation in one Markdown-compatible text file.
- [Quick start](https://edmogeor.github.io/dashmark/docs/guides/quick-start/): Run Dashmark with Docker Compose or Docker commands.
- [Card configuration](https://edmogeor.github.io/dashmark/docs/configuration/cards/): Docker labels, Traefik URL discovery, card ordering, icons, and access rules.
- [YAML configuration](https://edmogeor.github.io/dashmark/docs/configuration/yaml/): Overrides and standalone cards.
- [Dashboard settings](https://edmogeor.github.io/dashmark/docs/configuration/settings/): Environment variables and YAML settings.
- [Access control](https://edmogeor.github.io/dashmark/docs/configuration/access-control/): Trusted identity headers and card restrictions.
- [Metrics](https://edmogeor.github.io/dashmark/docs/metrics/): Container, library, and custom metrics.

## Source and support

- [Repository](https://github.com/edmogeor/dashmark)
- [Documentation source](https://github.com/edmogeor/dashmark/tree/main/docs/src/content/docs)
- [Configuration examples](https://github.com/edmogeor/dashmark/tree/main/config)
